base_member_text: HTTP (not HTTPS) endpoint @L361 and '&sensor=false' @L402 are deprecated Google Static Maps usages (2016-era); whether the API still serves them is external to this file

persistent apiKey initialized check 'if isnumeric(apiKey)' @L121 relies on uninitialized persistent being [] (numeric) — after 'apikey' property sets a string it is never reloaded from file in the same session; cross-line L120-127 vs L202-208
longitude clamps @L247-256 set curAxis(1)=0 when >180 and curAxis(2)=0 when <-180 — collapses rather than wraps the axis; intent unresolved
world-map default sets curAxis=[-200 200 -85 85] @L261 exceeding the just-enforced [-180,180] bounds
myTurboInterp2 y-direction search assumes descending Y (YI(idx) <= Y(1) && YI(idx) >= Y(end) @L586) matching yVec built height:-1:1 @L471 — works only for that orientation
uniImag initialized zeros(uniHeight,uniWidth,3) double @L484 then overwritten by uint8 gather @L487 — the preallocation is dead; image() receives uint8

update_google_map_fig appends 'Axis' to params @L634-637 but plot_google_map parses the lowercase 'axis' case @L172 via lower() @L171 — consistent, though params stored pre-lowercasing; relies on strcmpi @L635

audit_member_text: L459 already applies resize to imag; L463-L464 then measure that resized image, but L477-L478 multiply those measured dimensions by resize again before L485 resamples to the uniform grid. For resize values other than 1, the returned/plotted grid therefore applies the requested dimension factor twice (for example resize=2 produces another twofold output dimension after imresize).

L229 stores only the caller's original varargin. The zoom/pan callback obtains the event axes at L609 but discards that handle when it reloads params at L616 and recursively calls plot_google_map(params{:}) at L617; when the original call omitted Axis, the recursive call falls back to gca at L152 and can refresh a different axes in a multi-axes figure. The figure-resize callback separately adds the missing Axis at L635-L636, exposing the inconsistent callback interface.

Only scale is range-checked at L179-L182. resize and alphaData are accepted directly at L184 and L188; resize is later passed to imresize at L459 and used as a divisor at L468, so zero or negative values reach an invalid resize/division path instead of being rejected at the option boundary.

Degenerate axes spans pass the plausibility test at L233, yield zero projected extents at L269-L270, and can cause division by zero in the aspect corrections at L286 or L302 and zero minRes in the zoom calculation at L341-L346; there is no nonzero-span guard before those formulas.
